subject: [enc4k] payload-vcodec-fast(+kp) staged for q10jg; per-frame phase timing + --venc-keep-power in vcodecd/V40; vendor QUERY_CAP: H.264/HEVC max 3840x2176, level 5.1, HEVC Main only, + HEIF/MPEG4/H263
body: Probe 8c801de2: --venc-fast 0|1 (writes kern.n2vc.venc_fast before OPEN, logs read-back; ENOENT = kernel without 0312), --then 8th field fast|slow. vcodecd 481a147b: per-frame 'phases us' line (frames 1-3 + every 10th): power_on / GCE list (irq wait vs register batches) / power_off / other (IPI+interpreter+wait_done) + lists per core; V40 n2vcu got cumulative phase counters and an optional hold (--venc-keep-power: each VENC core stays powered from its first list to session end; released in session_end). Host real-vendor check: per-frame power ops 2 -> 0 with keep-power. IP 1079/1079 (two 5.2 cases removed, 4096 refusal added). Vendor QUERY_CAP (host runner, AP_IPIMSG_ENC_QUERY_CAP): encoders H264 (profiles Baseline|Main|High, max level 5.1, 16..3840/16 x 16..2176/8), H265 (Main only, max 5.1, same sizes), HEIF (16..16383), MPG4 (<=640x480), H263 (176x144 only); inputs NV12/NV21/I420/YV12 family + 10-bit (P010, MT10, M10S, P01S) + RGB/BGR 24/32 + RGBA1010102 + MTK compressed (MCN8/MCNX etc.). So 4096x2160 is outside the vendor caps: vcodecd now refuses width > 3840 (E_ARGS) and caps auto level at 5.1. Payloads (both --keepalive, restart-on-switch): payload-vcodec-fast and payload-vcodec-fastkp (same + --venc-keep-power): 0 avc1 4K30 High 273 MHz, 1 same 624 MHz, 2 avc1 4096x2160 (expect E_ARGS), 3 avc1 1080p60 High 4.2 fast, 4 hvc1 4K30 5.1 fast (restart), 5 hvc1 1080p60 4.1 fast. Needs q10jg. DVFSRC/vcore: nothing in user space can read it; add n2dram=1 to the q10jg pack --extra-args (0121: read-only DVFSRC page dump at boot, before/after DVFS) if you want the level in this boot.
